augmentation: RGB bilinear/mask nearest resize256, train horizontal flip p0.5; same epoch-derived order and flip stream
checkpoint_selection: maximum development validation global mIoU; earlier epoch wins exact tie
scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR T_max40 eta_min0, step after epoch
optimizer: AdamW, betas .9/.999 eps1e-8, global norm clip5
precision: AMP BF16 with FP32 weights; no GradScaler; TF32 disabled; strict deterministic
loss: BCEWithLogits + per-image soft IoU; no invented auxiliary heads

initialization.CGNet: Official kaiming initialization; fresh scratch; no segmentation warm start
initialization.LRASPP_prefix: Fresh cached ImageNet MobileNetV2 prefix + random unmodified torchvision LRASPPHead

batchnorm.CGNet: Native BN running statistics and affine parameters trained
batchnorm.LRASPP_prefix: Encoder running statistics frozen, affine trained; decoder BN trained

parameter_limit: No pruning or narrowing of official candidates; full binary inference model counted; same order of magnitude

benchmark.orders: forward/reverse/reverse/forward; alternate models after each sample
benchmark.timing: synchronized host perf_counter; model-only with normalization/output resize, excludes disk/decode/native postprocess
benchmark.memory: Fresh subprocess per model, absolute allocated/reserved peaks and incremental activation memory; benchmark shared-residency memory reported separately

fixed_budget_limitation: 40 epochs is not a convergence ceiling or original-paper reproduction
